com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-crypto-bc 00.79.30 发布, Optional Phase-1b extension that adds memory-hard and bcrypt-style
    password hashing providers backed by BouncyCastle (Argon2id,
    bcrypt, scrypt) on top of the V00.71 PasswordHashProvider SPI from
    jSentinel-core. Strictly opt-in: applications that do not depend on
    this module never pull in bcprov. Loading the module also does not
    touch the global JCA provider order — every algorithm is invoked
    through the BouncyCastle low-level Bouncy Castle Crypto APIs.

com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-oauth2 00.79.30 发布, V00.77 opt-in module: OAuth2 Relying-Party HTTP flows — authorization-code

    secret-jwt / private-key-jwt / none), refresh-token rotation with

    JwtSigner. Framework-neutral — no Vaadin / REST adapter types.

com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-persistence-eclipsestore 00.79.30 发布, Eclipse-Store-backed implementations of every Phase-2 persistence
    store (AuditEvent, Session, LoginAttempt, RoleAssignment,
    BootstrapState, RememberMe / PasswordReset / EmailVerification
    tokens, ApiKey, RefreshToken, RateLimit). Each implementation is
    verified bit-for-bit against the contract shipped by
    jSentinel-persistence-testkit. The runtime root object
    (EclipseStoreJSentinelRoot) is package-private — applications
    consume the stores through their existing Phase-2 SPIs and
    control the lifecycle through the public
    EclipseStoreJSentinelStorage facade.

com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-credentials-hibp 00.79.30 发布, Optional Phase-5 extension that adds a HaveIBeenPwned-style online
    compromised-password checker on top of the V00.71 SPI from
    jSentinel-core. The checker uses the k-anonymity range API: only
    the first five hex chars of the candidate's SHA-1 digest leave the
    process, never the plaintext password (CWE-359). The implementation
    relies on JDK HttpClient only — no additional runtime dependencies.
    Strictly opt-in; applications that do not depend on this module
    perform no online lookups.

items.title:
com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-jwt 00.79.30 发布, V00.76 opt-in module: Nimbus JOSE+JWT-backed default implementation of
    the jSentinel-core JWT SPIs (JwtValidator, JwksClient, JwtValidatorFactory)
    plus the JwtDiagnosticContributor. Framework-neutral — no Vaadin, no REST
    framework. The JOSE-free SPI contracts and result types live in
    jSentinel-core/jwt/api; this module is the only place a JOSE library is on
    the classpath. JWT/JWKS event types are published to jSentinel-events.

com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-propagation-processor 00.79.30 发布, Compile-time annotation processor that generates a Propagating
    wrapper for each @PropagateToken-annotated concrete class /
    interface. The generated wrapper binds the
    PropagateTokenAdvisor-resolved HeaderValue into
    OutboundHeaderContext around every annotated method.

    Runtime sibling: PropagatingProxy.wrap(...) in jSentinel-propagation
    for the JDK Dynamic Proxy path on interfaces.
